Name: Various Companions for Custom Companions
Author: mikemonroe
Description:
[size=4][b]Description

[/b][/size]Adds few companions to the game. They are [b]summoned by equipping rings[/b] that can be bought at the hatmouse, or spawned with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93/]CJB Item Spawner[/url]. The ring names all contain the string 'Companion' in them. The companions don't do anything practical, they just follow you.

The companions have some differences in behaviour, try them to see if you like one﻿ more than another. Walking type companions behave more naturally but get stuck in places (and are teleported to the player after a certain distance). All of them will most likely look bad when the player is moving fast.

The companions get stuck in the farm house. You can spawn a new one by re-equipping the ring outside. The house companions will be despawned at some point, but it's better to not sleep with the ring on.

None of the art is by me, the permissions are detailed in the licence files that accompany each companion.png file.



[size=4][b]Companions

[/b][/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/4sOenR1.png[/img]


[list=1]
[*][b]Heroine[/b]. "Ghost" type companion, goes through walls while slowly following you. No animations at all.
[*][b]Nordic Child[/b]. A nordic appearing girl. Gets stuck in walls, runs around when idle for too long.
[*][b]Red Riding Hood[/b].  Also "ghost" type, but more lively. More glitchy too.
[*][b]Witch Princess[/b]. Pretty much the same as the nordic child.
[/list]

[b][size=4]Installation

[/size][/b]Install any of the folders with '[CC]' in the name inside the 'Companions' folder to your mods folder. They can be used independently of each other. However there's no harm in just putting the 'Companions' folder to the mods folder if you want them all.



[b][size=4]Uninstallation[/size][/b]

Be sure to trash any rings from the mod before uninstalling it, otherwise your save can become corrupted. I recommend not removing the mod from a save unless necessary.



[b][size=5]Caution
[/size][/b]
When added to an on-going save the rings can cause modded item ids to change, sometimes resulting in bugged items, and rarely in more serious problems. It is adviced to make a backup of your save before installing the mod. CJB Item Spawner can be used to spawn new, working items in case something becomes non-functional.
